fixtures.name: bridge_seq
fixtures.dax:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE (
    ROW (
        "Market", [Market SEQ],
        "Market Mix", [Market Mix SEQ],
        "Propulsion Mix", [Propulsion Mix SEQ],
        "Content", [Content SEQ],
        "Price", [Price SEQ],
        "FX", [FX SEQ],
        "Total", [Total Revenue Change SEQ]
    ),
    'Period'[Quarter] = "2026-Q2"
)

fixtures.name: bridge_yoy
fixtures.dax:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE (
    ROW (
        "Market", [Market YoY],
        "Market Mix", [Market Mix YoY],
        "Propulsion Mix", [Propulsion Mix YoY],
        "Content", [Content YoY],
        "Price", [Price YoY],
        "FX", [FX YoY],
        "Total", [Total Revenue Change YoY]
    ),
    'Period'[Quarter] = "2026-Q2"
)

fixtures.name: drill_bu_yoy
fixtures.dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN (
    500,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
        'Business Unit'[BU Code],
        TREATAS ( { "2026-Q2" }, 'Period'[Quarter] ),
        "Market", [Market YoY],
        "Market Mix", [Market Mix YoY],
        "Propulsion Mix", [Propulsion Mix YoY],
        "Content", [Content YoY],
        "Price", [Price YoY],
        "FX", [FX YoY],
        "Total", [Total Revenue Change YoY]
    ),
    [Total], DESC
)
